sentences.en: I am slowly acclimatising myself to the harsh climate here.
sentences.zh: 我正在逐渐适应这里的恶劣气候。

sentences.en: The Chinese in the Philippines acclimatized to a somewhat Hispanic culture.
sentences.zh: 在中国菲律宾的华人逐渐适应了略带西班牙文化色彩的环境。

sentences.en: They have not yet acclimatised themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们还没有完全适应新环境。

senses.zh: 服水土,适应新气候或环境
